module: Flowgraph node "Get Drag Race Winner Data" (category repeat_instant). Gives the player's result at the end of a drag race. Outputs: playerWin, playerPos (position), dialDiff (player's ET + RT minus their dial), threshold (best opponent minus player in ET + RT; positive if the player crosses the line first). Source: dragBridge.getPlayerRaceResult or getWinnersData.
notes: If the winners are unavailable or empty, a node error is set and the outputs are not modified.
dialDiff and threshold are only filled if getPlayerRaceResult exists.

work.desc: Reads the bridge result and feeds the used outputs.
